desktop.notes:
• ★ Suggest favourites (AI menu on the computer, ⋮ on the phone): the strongest photos of the folder - top 10, 50, 100 or the best 10 % - for you to approve. A harsh critic (no soft, badly exposed, cut-off or eyes-closed shots, nothing you or the AI discarded), one per burst / similar set, scored by sharpness, subject, the AI and your own style, with variety: the same subject again counts less. Every pick says why. All ticked - untick and make them ★ in one go (Ctrl+Z undoes).
• Smart Best Shot: the recommended frame of each burst now says all it won on - sharpest subject, eyes open, whole subject in the frame, largest subject, best exposure, your kind of photo.
• Going back after an update (computer): Settings → Updates → "Go back to …" puts the previous version back (it is kept by every update) and restarts; you can switch forward again. "Skip this version" stops the offer.
• New app icon (Windows and Android).
